bio: I'm a computer engineer and PhD student in Computer Science at NTNU, having just completed my MSc (2024–2026) with a thesis on the Visual Mamba (ViM) architecture — exploring state-space models as an alternative to transformers for vision tasks. I'm also the founder of Raven Labs AS. I'm a proactive learner drawn to fast-moving fields like AI and Web3, and I like turning research ideas into working software.

Recent work spans building an AI pipeline that turns natural-language prompts into BigQuery queries at Sticos, leading a small intern team through a production web rebuild at Bouvet, and teaching and mentoring at NTNU since 2023 — including as an Education Mentor supporting a student's academic path in computer science, AI and mathematics. I value clear communication and building things that actually get used.

certs.name: PhD Computer Science, NTNU — in progress
